extras: Relies on internal renderer APIs that may change in future Obsidian versions. It is desktop-only.
intentEvidence: An Obsidian plugin that makes the graph view pan when you scroll, instead of zooming.
motivation: Built with trackpad users in mind.
problem: The default graph view behavior requires click-and-dragging to pan, while scrolling only zooms.
summary: A plugin that allows users to pan the graph view by scrolling instead of zooming, moving zoom functionality to pinch or modifier key combinations.
